_note: Stores read directly from their pages. All start disabled. Enable one only after checking the store's terms allow it, then set the selectors (open the store's search page, right-click a product > Inspect) and test with: node server/sources/scraper.js <id> "iphone 17 pro". If a page exposes schema.org JSON-LD the selectors are not needed. sellerName must match a 'match' entry in stores.json so the store gets its Arabic name and delivery rules.
